best_practices.description: Use at most one primary button per surface.
Prefer verb labels such as "Save" over "OK".

documentation:
Triggers the main action on a screen or dialog.
Use one primary `AcmeButton` per surface and pair it with a secondary
variant for alternative actions.

parameters.description: Visible label. Keep it to a short verb phrase such as "Save".
parameters.name: label

parameters.description: Called when the user activates the button.
parameters.name: onClick

parameters.description: When true, the button ignores input and renders as disabled.
parameters.name: disabled
